title: My better netherite weapons
description: The resource pack changes boring netherite weapons into something new!
body:
The texture pack changes boring netherite weapons into something new! The sword looks like a dark, curved samurai katana, and the spear like something you wouldn’t want to be hit by.
 
The texture pack also works on the latest versions, but Minecraft shows the pack as broken or incompatible.
 
!!! MADE IN POLAND !!!
